environment: macOS arm64; fresh temporary DZMM_NEXT_DATA_DIR; freshly rebuilt PyInstaller onedir sidecar and Tauri debug app; packaged sidecar loopback port 18765

implementation.host_control_plane: Only loopback Host can list pending pairing requests and active gameplay devices, approve a pending request, or revoke an active device. LAN requests remain limited to /api/v2/mobile/* before endpoint dispatch.
implementation.desktop: When LAN gameplay is enabled, the Mac desktop exposes a mobile-pairing panel with refresh, local approval and revoke actions. It does not display approval codes or mobile tokens.

verification.backend: 52 pytest cases and Ruff passed. Pairing coverage proves empty/pending/active list transitions, one-time approval, token issuance, revocation and remote Host-management rejection.
verification.desktop: vue-tsc and Vite production build passed.
verification.packaging: Fresh PyInstaller build and CI=true npx tauri build --debug passed. The package sidecar migrated an isolated database and returned 200 for /health, /api/v2/host/mobile-devices and /api/v2/host/pairing-requests.

boundary: This completes the Mac-side pairing control surface but does not implement the Android narrative gameplay client or constitute physical pairing, LAN recovery, revoke, conflict or disconnect evidence. Android recovery remains 0 and the matrix remains 66.25/100.
